context: Reproduce the silent retention with a regression test, then make the failure branch fail closed by abandoning quick restart and returning to the interactive flow, or exiting with a clear error when interaction is unavailable. Keep the diff minimal so the later run-plan refactor can absorb the behavior without rework. Do not attempt to refresh the broader derived state; that repair belongs to the refactor item.
description: Confirmed defect three from the 2026-08-08 architecture review evaluation. _interactive_try_quick_restart in benchbox/cli/commands/run.py re-resolves tuning after quick restart overwrites platform, benchmark, and tuning from the saved run, but on ValueError it silently retains the pre-restart resolution via an except-pass, so the recorded canonical tuning mode and provenance can disagree with the executed configuration. This item lands only the narrow fail-closed repair and its regression tests ahead of the systemic replay refactor owned by refactor-to-derive-cli-command-from-resolved-config-objects, whose atomic re-resolution work later absorbs this branch. The broader derived-state replay defect (platform key, phases, tuning flags and files, unified config, and related fields) is explicitly out of scope here.

anti_patterns.dont: Expand this fix into the RunRequest and ResolvedRunPlan refactor.
anti_patterns.instead: Land the narrow fail-closed branch and regression tests only.
anti_patterns.why: The systemic replay repair is owned by refactor-to-derive-cli-command-from-resolved-config-objects.

anti_patterns.dont: Keep a silently retained stale TuningResolution when re-resolution fails.
anti_patterns.instead: Fail closed by abandoning quick restart or exiting with a clear error.
anti_patterns.why: Executed and recorded configuration can disagree without any visible signal.

anti_patterns.dont: Re-derive only the displayed canonical mode on the failure branch.
anti_patterns.instead: Make execution and the canonical record read the same re-resolved state or abort.
anti_patterns.why: The record would match the display while execution still used stale state.

preserves.behavior: Existing table-mode precedence behavior during quick restart is unchanged.
Quick restart continues to work unchanged for valid saved configurations.
Recorded canonical tuning mode and provenance agree with the executed configuration on the failure branch.
The interactive configuration flow remains reachable when quick restart is abandoned.

prior_art.concept: Quick-restart re-resolution branch with commented silent retention on ValueError.
Systemic replay refactor that later absorbs this branch into atomic re-resolution.

verifications.expected: Selected quick-restart tests pass including the new failed-re-resolution cases.

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check benchbox/cli/commands/run.py tests/unit/cli

verifications.description: Stale-resolution regression is falsifiable on the unfixed tree
verifications.expected: This command exits nonzero on the unfixed tree when failed re-resolution silently retains the pre-restart resolution and exits zero after the fail-closed repair.

work_units.summary: Pin a regression test where resolve_tuning raises ValueError during quick restart and the run silently proceeds with the pre-restart resolution
Implement fail-closed behavior that abandons quick restart to the interactive flow or exits with a clear error instead of silently retaining the stale resolution
Add regression coverage for the failure fallback, provenance and execution agreement on the failure branch, and unchanged valid-restart behavior
Restore the silent-retention except-pass as a negative control, prove the focused test fails, then restore the fix
